column1: # English for menu text the PS1 translation leaves in Japanese (it is in the overlays' data, which
# the Windows port compiled into Persona.exe). tools/install_english.py menu_text() finds every
# copy of the Japanese in the exe.
#   kind msg     : a dialogue-interpreter message (16 px font), redirected like msg_text.bin
#   (the Japanese may be given as hex:bytes where the font table has no single character for a glyph)
#   kind inplace : a 16 px string other code copies into a message; English in its own bytes
#   kind cells:N : a small-font label of N cells written into a menu map; replaced in place
#                  (padded with spaces; it must fit in N cells)
